name: Nagylengyel (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and yellow at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Nagylengyel (a green shield with a yellow charge) above the name NAGYLENGYEL in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
